/v/labpack

'Labpack' is the unofficial name for a Minecraft Modpack designed by popular Youtuber Ethoslab for his single player modded Youtube series. You can find a playlist of the series here, where he delves into a lot of the tech mods and creates some really neat AI for his world. The modpack was released on the Feed The Beast launcher as a third party pack.

Download instructions can be found on the subverse.

I think the easiest way to implement it would be to have details of a sub come up when you hover over a link to it, similar to what happens when you hover over a username. From that little popup you can subscribe or block a sub. I don't know how easy that would be to do though.

The block is especially urgent. There are tons of subs that are extremely offensive or inappropriate to many users. I recognize the importance of an open platform, but without an easy filter mechanism it will drive away a large set of good potential users. We should be able to block a sub and never see it again in one click, any time the title is displayed.
